::: content
For months an online [debate](http://blogs.discovermagazine.com/badastronomy/2008/03/29/no-the-lhc-wont-destroy-the-earth/) has raged about whether the new [Linear Hadron Collider](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_Hadron_Collider) in Switzerland would create black holes that could "destroy the earth."

Well, the [LHC is now online](http://community.zdnet.co.uk/blog/0,1000000567,10009272o-2000331761b,00.htm), and apparently, it has not destroyed the earth. Either that, or we're living in an episode of `<cite>`{=html}Lost`</cite>`{=html}.
:::
